description: This Kotlin source file defines a custom Android view named ContinueWatchingCard, which displays a thumbnail, a title, and a specially styled progress indicator, designed for Android TV with D-pad navigation support. The view adheres to specific layout specifications and emphasizes accessibility, focus handling, and precise layout dimensions.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingCard
classes.description: A custom Android CardView that displays a thumbnail image, a title, and a progress bar indicating the watch progress. It is optimized for TV navigation with focus scaling and RTL support, and conforms to specific layout metrics for a consistent UI experience.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Associates a ContentItem with the card view, updating the title and progress bar to reflect the item's data.

methods.name: applyProgressToFill
methods.description: Calculates and sets the width of the progress fill indicator based on the provided progress fraction, handling layout updates.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts integer density-independent pixels (dp) to pixel units.

methods.name: dpToPxF
methods.description: Converts floating point dp (used for fractional dimensions) to pixel units.
